heroText: Madrid works best as a base in Spain when you anchor days around Prado Museum, Royal Palace of Madrid and Plaza Mayor Madrid. Use those sights to understand the city's history, street life and visitor rhythm. Madrid Barajas handles the main arrival flow, so hotel choice should balance the centre, transfer time and day-trip plans.

stayOverview: Start with Centro for the easiest first Madrid stay, then compare Malasana and Salamanca when price, nightlife, quieter evenings or transfer timing matter more than being beside every major sight.
hotelIntro: Madrid hotel choice is mostly about repeat journeys: use Centro for sightseeing, Malasana for a different local base, and Salamanca or Retiro when views, parking, airport timing or longer stays matter.
rentalCars: Do not rent a car for central Madrid unless parking and traffic are part of the plan; use one mainly for regional day trips.

history.label: 9th century
history.text: In the second half of the 9th century, Umayyad Emir Muhammad I built a fortress on a headland near the river Manzanares as one of the many fortresses he ordered built on the border.
Madrid, located near Alcalá (under Muslim control until 1118), remained a borderland for a while, suffering a number of razzias during the Almoravid period, and its walls were destroyed in 1110.
The 1123 Charter of Otorgamiento established the first explicit limits between Madrid and Segovia, namely the Puerto de El Berrueco and the Puerto de Lozoya.
In 1202, Alfonso VIII gave Madrid its first charter to regulate the municipal council, which was expanded in 1222 by Ferdinand III.
